name: qb-core-port-wip
author: u-core (TS port of qbcore-framework/qb-core)
description: WIP port of qb-core. Server side fully ported (Functions/Player/Events/Exports/Debug). Client side covers Functions/Events/Loops/DrawText with vehicle-properties getters/setters as core-fields-only stubs. The `-port-wip` suffix keeps this from claiming the `qb-core` resource name while upstream is still authoritative; we rename to plain `qb-core` and patch the txAdmin recipe once Phase 4 (locale) lands and we've verified end-to-end against the existing qb-multicharacter / qb-spawn flow.
